text:
ops-bot: [incident] paging oncall - halo-prod dedicated pool reporting elevated 5xx and p99 latency. alert: 1.2% 5xx over 5m, traffic spike detected. pager: @alex

alex: I'm on it — seeing node-gpu-03 CPU at 96%, KV cache evictions spike, reconnect storms from several sessions. autoscaler didn't kick (cooldown still 300s).

maria: joining. looks like a noisy tenant pattern, suspect tenant id tid-ACME01 from recent batch ingestion. starting isolation plan: move suspected sessions to isol-pool and enable throttles.

jordan: confirmed heavy vectorize jobs from tid-ACME01, burst of long-context requests (12k tokens). pushing per-tenant rate limit  -> 10r/s for that tenant now.

alex: applied throttle. immediate effect: 5xx down to 0.4%, p99 from ~2300ms -> ~700ms. good signal.

maria: I'll start an ephemeral isolate pool and evict remaining ACME sessions; will also snapshot logs for RCA. @elaine-cs please notify ACME CSM that we're mitigating and will follow with RCA + credits.

elaine-cs: pinged ACME CSM and sent short customer note: "We're seeing degraded inference in your dedicated pool; we've isolated noisy workloads and applied temporary rate limits to restore service. We'll follow up with RCA and proposed credits." CSM acknowledged and asked for exec briefing.

ops-bot: automation created incident-7298456000, severity: S2, runbook: tenant-isolation -> create isolate pool -> throttle -> confirm metrics.

samir: oncall handoff note: alex handing to samir in 10m for watch. samir will run a 30m observation and coordinate post-incident items.

alex: handoff done. key notes in the bridge: root cause looks like tenant ramp + autoscaler cooldown too long for sudden burst. mitigation: isolate tenant, apply rate limit, scale up isolate pool.

maria: proposed permanent actions: 1) reduce autoscaler cooldown from 300s -> 60s for dedicated pools, 2) add tenant-level soft quotas and automated preemptive throttles, 3) add KV cache eviction alerts. I'll draft RCA.

elaine-cs: ACME asked about compensation — propose 48 hours of service credit + offer a 30-minute exec briefing next week. they said they value a clear timeline for fixes.

jordan: snippet of the quick config change I applied: ```diff
-autoscaler.cooldown: 300s
+autoscaler.cooldown: 60s

-tenant_quota.default: 200r/s
+tenant_quota.default: 100r/s
```

samir: action items recorded in incident doc: draft RCA, schedule exec briefing, implement autoscale cooldown change in staging, add tenant quota enforcement. assigning owners: maria (RCA + infra fix), jordan (config rollout), elaine-cs (customer comms + credits).

alex: metrics stable for 10m, leaving bridge. closing live mitigation in 30m if no regressions. great work everyone :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident status: mitigated (live traffic normalized). follow-up: RCA draft due in 48h, exec briefing tentatively Fri 10:00 PT.
